text: dsh-plugin-scaffold 是一个面向 DSH Web 客户端的插件脚手架示例，展示配置、工具注册、结果呈现和会话事件钩子的扩展方式。它同时提供一个可用的持久笔记示例：通过工具创建或替换笔记、按键读取、列出笔记键和删除笔记，数据保存到本地 JSON 文件。配置可调整文件路径和笔记数量上限，写入会拒绝空键、空内容及超过上限的新笔记。适合开发 DSH 社区插件并参考工具与本地存储实现；不需要 API 密钥或外部账号。

dsh-plugin-scaffold shows DSH Web plugin configuration, tools, result cards, and session hooks. Its note tools save, read, list, and delete notes in a local JSON file, with configurable path and size limit. Useful as a community plugin example; no API key or external account is needed.
想给 DSH 加一组能保存和读取命名笔记的工具。
需要在会话中列出已有笔记键，并能删除指定笔记。
我想参考一个带配置、工具和结果卡片的 DSH 插件例子。
dsh-plugin-scaffold 的功能「持久笔记工具」：工具可按名称创建或替换笔记、读取单条笔记、列出笔记及删除笔记；调用工具时以笔记键或内容为输入，数据保存在配置路径的 JSON 文件中。
dsh-plugin-scaffold 的功能「插件扩展示例」：加载插件时注册笔记工具、为调用和结果生成呈现数据，并监听会话 turn/end 事件；配置 schema 提供笔记文件路径和数量上限，便于作为社区插件开发起点。

dsh-plugin-scaffold README · dsh-plugin-scaffold：A starter [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) plugin.
It demonstrates the four extension shapes a community plugin can use, shipped as a
working persistent note scratchpad: `note_write` / `note_read` / `note_list` / `note_delete`.

dsh-plugin-scaffold README · dsh-plugin-scaffold：| Shape | Where in this repo |
|---|---|
| Plugin with `Config` | `src/index.ts` — Schemastery schema, defaults, cordis.yml overrides |
| Tools | `ctx.tools.register(defineTool(...))` — canonical JSON outputs + `output.render` |
| UI cards | `presentCall` / `presentResult` / `presentationMeta` — pure projections |
| Hooks | `ctx.on('session/event', ...)` — observe the agent loop |

dsh-plugin-scaffold README · Try it：Install the bundle into any profile (the `prepare` script builds on install):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Tianbaidi/dsh-plugin-scaffold
```

Open the Web UI and ask the agent to `save a note called project-ideas
about the scaffold, then list all notes`.

Prefer a dev overlay instead? Point it at your local checkout:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: scaffold
      name: 'file:///<path-to-plugin>/src/index.ts'
```

dsh-plugin-scaffold README · Try it：> Windows note: plugin paths in overlays must be `file://` URLs
> (`file:///D:/...%20...`), not bare `D:/...` paths — the ESM loader rejects
> the latter as scheme `d:`.

dsh-plugin-scaffold README · Develop：```sh
pnpm install        # installs the published @deepseek-ai peer packages
pnpm typecheck      # strict TypeScript check against published .d.ts
pnpm test           # vitest: config defaults, tool round-trips, limits, presenters
```

Hot reload: edit `src/index.ts`, save, and the running `dsh web` reloads the
plugin (registrations are effects and clean themselves up).

dsh-plugin-scaffold README · Make it yours：1. Rename the package and the `name` export in `src/index.ts`.
2. Replace the note domain with yours — keep the Config/tool/card/hook shapes.
3. Rebuild the `cordis.yml` `name:` file URL to point at your `src/index.ts`.

dsh-plugin-scaffold README · Publish to the ecosystem：This project is already a **bundle** (`dsh.bundle.patch` in `package.json`), the
official distribution format: install it into any profile with `dsh plugin add`.

```sh

dsh-plugin-scaffold README · from a dsh installation (npm or source checkout):：dsh plugin --profile my-profile add /path/to/dsh-plugin-scaffold
dsh --profile my-profile "save a note about the scaffold"
```

> Windows note: `dsh plugin add` forwards the path to pnpm, which splits on
> spaces — keep the package on a path without spaces, or use a tarball.

dsh-plugin-scaffold README · from a dsh installation (npm or source checkout):：1. Push this project to your own GitHub repository.
2. Add the [`dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) topic to your repo
   so the community can discover it.
3. Users can then install straight from GitHub (`dsh plugin --profile my-profile
   add github:you/dsh-plugin-scaffold`). The `prepare` script builds `lib/` from
   source on install — pnpm will ask you to allowlist the build once
   (see the [package-and-install tutorial](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/user/develop/basic/publish.md)).
4. (Optional) `npm publish` to make it installable by name.
